title: Perspective Transition of Large Language Models for Solving Subjective Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on subjective disambiguation tasks using the Pronoun Resolution dataset (Winogender schemas by Rudinger et al., 2018), which tests coreference resolution involving gendered pronouns and occupations.

Measuring the model's performance (Accuracy and F1 scores) on culturally-related Natural Language Inference (NLI) datasets, specifically SocNorm, e-SocNorm, and CALI, to assess its ability to understand and reason about diverse sociocultural norms.
